LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_DominionVerdictLens.des: A pale verdict lens that teaches a modular turret to recognize authority, mass and shielded command bodies before lesser targets can steal its attention.
A crown-fed pressure choir that drives the weapon path into a harsher rhythm, burning power and stability for a faster verdict cycle.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_SepulcherFailSafeMantle: A sepulcher mantle of dead-brass clamps and black failsafe relays. It keeps a turret body standing when the shield has already spent itself.
